formalScope.availabilityCommit: The physical final no-clobber ready hardlink is the availability linearization. When syscall outcome is interrupted, same owned output directory plus regular final ready inode matching the staged inode establishes commit before rollback decisions.
formalScope.ownershipAssumptions: Cooperating directory writers, stable owned directory/ready inode identities and inherited child process-group membership; this is not hostile-process/filesystem sandboxing or crash durability.

Ordinary staging-cleanup OSError without primary returns cleanup_pending; with primary it marks safe loss without replacement.
